description: Defines numeric types, conversions, and bit array classes for internal core functionality, including number serialization, deserialization, and network byte order handling.

classes.name: NumberType
classes.description: Template class for numeric types supporting serialization, deserialization, and network byte order conversions.

classes.name: Fractional
classes.description: Represents fractional numbers with integer and remainder parts, supporting conversion and text representation.

classes.name: BitArrayBaseType
classes.description: Base class for fixed-size bit array with set, clear, and find operations.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts string representations to numeric types, supporting different bases and signedness.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns string representation of the number.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes number to string or wide string.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes number from string or wide string.
